translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Bata-bata Yakub la sitammu Esau
Tappana umpatahhu' pa'laoanna Yakub, iya natammuim sanaka-naka malaika'na Puang Allataala.
Pissananna naita Yakub indo malaika', iya nauam: “Inde pebahunganna Puang Allataala.” Iam too anna nasangaim Yakub indo ongeam Mahanaim.
Puhai ia too, ussuam sanaka-naka tau mendiolo umpellambi'i Esau kakanna lako Seir battu diua Edom.
Naua Yakub ma'pakahi'di lako indo ingganna to nasua: “Uaanni puäku Esau: susi inde tula'na sabua'mu Yakub: ‘O puäku, si dioä' banuanna Laban mentihuham sule lako temo.
Tentomai deemmi kuampuam sapim, keledai, domba, beke, anna sabua' muane anna baine. Anna kupalambi'iko inde kaheba umba ke uhhäntängannä' bua anna malaä' untahima manappa.’”
Tappana ma'pasulei indo to nasua Yakub nauaammi: “Puhangkam le'ba' umpellambi'i Esau kakammu. Temo mahassammi muola lalam natammuiko umpasola appa' hatu' tau.”
Nahingnginna Yakub ia too tappa tinggi'gi' mahea' anna manangnga penabanna. Iya namaja-majam napa'dua indo taunna. Susi toi duka' ingganna dombana, bekena, sapinna, anna untana.
Aka naua inabanna: “Maka' sule Esau anna nagasa'i sabaheam, iya malapi lahi sabaheam.”
Anna mane ma'sambajam Yakub naua: “O Puang Allataala to napenombai neneku Abraham anna ambeku Ishak. O DEBATA, Iko puha muuaannä': ‘Pa'pasuleko lako bottomu anna kasahapuammu anna la kuolaangko.’

Tä'ä' la sihatam untahima ingganna pa'kamasemu sola kamanontongammu to puha umpogausannä'. Aka indo anna mengkalaoä' umpellei bottoku ullambam inde Salu Yordan, tä' deem aka kubaba sulibanna tekkengku. Tentomai ma'pasulemä' umpasola inde dua lengkoam tau sitonda olo'-olo'.
Kupelau sola ponno penaba anna ullappasannä' dio mai aha'na kakangku Esau, aka mahea'ä' sule manii napateiä' sola baineku anna ingganna änä'ku.
Aka puha muuaannä': ‘La kuolaangko anna la buda pessubummu, lambi' tä' deem tau la umbelai naissa' aka la susi budanna bungim dio bihim le'bo'.’”
Iya ma'bengim Yakub dio. Mebengngi'i mualam sabaheam olo'-olo'na la nabeem Esau kakanna.
Indo la nabeem, dua hatu' beke bihä, dua pulo beke laki, dua hatu' domba bihä, dua pulo domba laki,
tallu pulo unta bihä kalaoanna umpasusu änä'na, appa' pulo sapim bihä, sapulo sapim laki, dua pulo keledai bihä, anna sapulo keledai laki.
Nabahe-bahem indo olo'-olo' pantam napopa'mesa mane nabeenni lako sabua'na tungga' najagai. Mane nauai: “Pendiolongkoa' lao sapo' la muäto'a' pellaomu, sallaoam oi too lalla oom alla'na solana.”
Anna ma'pakahi'dii Yakub lako indo sabua'na handam mendiolo naua: “Maka' sitammuko kakangku Esau anna nakutanaiko naua: ‘Menna puämu? La umbako? Menna puäna inde mai olo'-olo' uhhambaa'?’
La muuaam: ‘Olo'-olo'na Yakub sabua'mu la nabeengko. Anna indo Yakub diom duka' mai natuhu'kam.’”
Susi siam duka' pepakahi'dinna lako sabua' to mentuhu' kaduanna, katallunna anna ingganna tau to nasua uhhamba indo olo'-olo' naua: “La susi siam tula'mu lako Esau ke ullambi'i.
Anna la muuaa': ‘Sabua'mu Yakub diom duka' mai boko'ki.’” Aka napikki' Yakub naua: “Iam too inde pa'pebeem la umpamehe aha'na Esau. Umba-umba aka malaä' naihusam uwai sumule.”
Dadi napa'pakatuam yolo indo olo'-olo' pa'lalam penabanna anna ma'bengipi ia dio indo to naongei mebahum.
Yakub sibobo' Puang Allataala mehhupatau
Bengi eta too bangom Yakub anna umpasolai lao bainena dua anna baine lolä'na dua anna sapulo mesa änä'na ullambam salu Yabok.
Puhai napalambam, ma'pasulem Yakub anna umpopebaba asanni aka-akanna dipalambam.
Sapo' tohho ia Yakub mesa-mesanna. Iya sulem mesa muane sibobo' Yakub sule lako moni mäne'.
Tappana nasi'dim indo tau tä' la patalo, iya uhhaka'um palona Yakub sampe silesa too' apanna.
Anna mane ma'kada indo tau naua: “Lappa'ä' aka la masiäm.” Sapo' natimba' Yakub naua: “Tä'ko la kulappasam ke tä'i umpa'lambeannä' yolo.”
Mekutanam indo tau naua: “Aka sangammu?” Naua: “Isangaä' Yakub.”
Iya nauam indo tau: “Tä'ungko la disangai Yakub aka puhangko umbali Puang Allataala anna hupatau, iya pataloko. Iam too anna la disangaingko Israel.”
Iya naua oom Yakub: “Tulasannä' duka' sangammu.” Sapo' natimba'i indo tau naua: “Tä' manggi' umpekutanaam sangangku.” Anna mane untamba' Yakub.
Iya nauam Yakub: “Puhamä' siita Puang Allataala, iya mala mammapä' tubo!” Iam too anna nasangaim indo ongeam Pniel.
Bihha'i allo umpelleim Pniel Yakub, sapo' heppä'um aka silesa too' apanna.
Iam too anna sule lako temo ingganna pessubunna Israel tä' lium ia muande bale too' apanna olo'-olo' aka too' apanna Yakub nahaka' Puang Allataala.
